headlines.title: Centrica boss says he is 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
headlines.summary: Chris O'Shea says the number of people unable or unwilling to pay their energy bills will increase when prices jump in the new year.

headlines.title: Israel forecast to grow 4.5%: What can Europe learn from its tech boom?
headlines.summary: Israel's tech-powered economy is set to overtake Sweden and Ireland to become the world's 25th-largest in 2026, the IMF says, amid years of war. As European and Israeli policymakers gather in Jerusalem this week to discuss closer ties, what can Europe learn from its innovation model?

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Lucy Powell promotes UK education in China despite risks
headlines.summary: The U.K. education secretary's visit to Beijing comes days after Wes Streeting praised the government for stepping up its interaction with China.

headlines.title: What is going on with Poundland?
headlines.summary: Poundland has a matter of days to find a buyer or face collapsing into administration. Why?

headlines.title: Is Europe ready to judge workers by skills, not just diplomas? Who leads skills-first hiring?
headlines.summary: Employers across Europe increasingly value skills while formal qualifications are still significant. Euronews Business takes a close look at which countries are most ready for a skills-first approach with experts explaining the gaps.

headlines.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs, citing ongoing losses — reports
headlines.summary: According to a letter obtained by the media, Lufthansa s executive board said the German company is losing €20 million every month. In addition to job cuts, operational cuts are also planned.

headlines.title: Global climate talks have collapsed. Here’s what just happened.
headlines.summary: Two weeks of talks about protecting the planet from global warming ended without a deal.

headlines.title: Energy bills will soar - here's how you can ease the pain
headlines.summary: Household energy bills are about to increase but there are ways to keep a lid on your expenditure.

headlines.title: Real Madrid outpace Bayern Munich in revenue race as both clubs post record figures
headlines.summary: Real Madrid have widened the financial gap over Bayern Munich, generating more than €1.2 billion in revenue in the 2025-26 season. The German champions are also approaching the billion-euro mark, while celebrating a record 500,000 members.

headlines.title: Anthropic trading tests investors appetite for AI
headlines.summary: Anthropic was valued at $2 trillion after shares started trading on the Nasdaq following a record $81 billion IPO. Its performance will put investor confidence in AI to the test.

headlines.title: Global left rallies in Paris to make ‘not so radical’ case for taxing billionaires
headlines.summary: Politicians from Europe and the U.S. gathered at Gabriel Zucman's summit to challenge the power of the super-rich — but few are in a position to act.

headlines.title: Employers are being asked to give interview feedback - here's what applicants want
headlines.summary: People say they often hear nothing back after applying for jobs. But could employers be forced to respond to every applicant?

headlines.title: Norway signs carbon credit deals with Indonesia and Morocco to help fund renewable energy
headlines.summary: Norway’s carbon credit purchases will help finance projects that might otherwise go unbuilt, while allowing it to count emissions cuts towards its own targets.

headlines.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
headlines.summary: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

headlines.title: Cyprus expels Russian diplomats on suspicion of espionage
headlines.summary: The two men were suspected of working for Russian intelligence services under diplomatic cover.

headlines.title: Can AI really help spot Black Friday deals? We put it to the test
headlines.summary: We put four AI models to the test to see if they could save us money on a new TV.

headlines.title: Chevron to begin offshore oil and gas exploration in Greece
headlines.summary: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY are set to begin seismic surveys for oil and gas in Greece’s southern Ionian Sea. The results could help determine whether to drill in a country that relies on imported gas.

headlines.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?
headlines.summary: The sharp sell-off in tech stocks after the US midterms and the Nvidia scandal has cast doubt on Anthropic s IPO. Yet with hundreds of billions still being invested, some think the AI party is still in full swing.

headlines.title: COP31 : l’accord capote sur fond de désaccord sur les énergies fossiles
headlines.summary: Les négociations n’ont pas réussi à aboutir sur un accord malgré les avertissements concernant un réchauffement climatique galopant.

trend_headline: 루프트한자 구조조정과 치솟는 에너지 비용의 충격
summary: 루프트한자가 월 2,000만 유로의 적자와 연료비 급등을 이유로 1,000명 감원을 발표했으며, 영국 센트리카 등 유틸리티 업계는 겨울철 에너지 요금 폭등에 따른 가계 부담을 경고하고 나섰다. 지정학적 리스크와 비용 압박이 맞물리며 유럽 항공 및 에너지 섹터의 수익성 우려가 고조되는 양상이다.
key_points: 독일 루프트한자, 프랑크푸르트·뮌헨 등지에서 1,000명 규모 감원 및 구조조정 발표 (월 2,000만 유로 손실 기록)
영국 센트리카(Centrica) 등 주요 에너지 기업, 신년 에너지 요금 인상과 가계 체납 급증에 대한 우려 표명
